headline: Greece Approves 10% Tax on Crypto Gains and 15% Levy on DeFi Income
summary: Greece approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains and a 15% levy on decentralized finance income. Investors are given 12 months to declare past gains without facing late-filing penalties.
why: Tax policy changes directly impact crypto asset valuations, investor compliance costs, and adoption rates within the affected jurisdiction.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrencies
impacts.why: Introduction of capital gains and income taxes directly affects returns for cryptocurrency investors in Greece.
